exitSearch.result: No Tiger exit, Summit owner transfer, redemption or signed pending ownership transaction was identified. Tiger and Summit Agricultural Group remain current; Continental remained invested at December 31, 2025. The current status of the earlier TPG Rise Climate, SK E&S and Deere investments remains unresolved.
